-- Serviços necessários
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Desativa o controle de toque padrão do Roblox para o script assumir
LocalPlayer.DevTouchMovementMode = Enum.DevTouchMovementMode.Scriptable

-- Criação da Interface (GUI)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AnalogicoDeltaCustomizado"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Tenta colocar no CoreGui (esconde do jogo) ou no PlayerGui
local success = pcall(function()
    gui.Parent = gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not success then
    gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- 1. ZONA DE TOQUE E ANALÓGICO (Totalmente invisível e livre de visão)
local zonaToque = Instance.new("TextButton")
zonaToque.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 240)
zonaToque.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -230) -- Fixo na marcação branca
zonaToque.BackgroundTransparency = 1
zonaToque.Text = ""
zonaToque.AutoButtonColor = false
zonaToque.Active = true
zonaToque.Parent = gui

local fundoAnalogico = Instance.new("Frame")
fundoAnalogico.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 140)
fundoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -70, 0.5, -70)
fundoAnalogico.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fundoAnalogico.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
fundoAnalogico.Visible = true
fundoAnalogico.Parent = zonaToque

-- 2. PINO DO ANALÓGICO (Botão Verde)
local pinoAnalogico = Instance.new("Frame")
pinoAnalogico.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
pinoAnalogico.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
pinoAnalogico.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
pinoAnalogico.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pinoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pinoAnalogico.Parent = fundoAnalogico

local cantoPino = Instance.new("UICorner")
cantoPino.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
cantoPino.Parent = pinoAnalogico

-- 3. BOTÃO DE PULO CUSTOMIZADO (Simples e funcional)
local botaoPuloCustom = Instance.new("ImageButton")
botaoPuloCustom.Name = "JumpButtonCustom"
botaoPuloCustom.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
botaoPuloCustom.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, -130)
botaoPuloCustom.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
botaoPuloCustom.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
botaoPuloCustom.Image = "rbxassetid://6074252252"
botaoPuloCustom.AutoButtonColor = true
botaoPuloCustom.Parent = gui

local cantoPulo = Instance.new("UICorner")
cantoPulo.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
cantoPulo.Parent = botaoPuloCustom

local bordaPulo = Instance.new("UIStroke")
bordaPulo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
bordaPulo.Thickness = 2
bordaPulo.Parent = botaoPuloCustom

-- Variável para controlar o pulo contínuo sem delay
local estaPulando = false

botaoPuloCustom.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        estaPulando = true
    end
end)

local function soltarPulo(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        estaPulando = false
    end
end

botaoPuloCustom.InputEnded:Connect(soltarPulo)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(soltarPulo)

-- Variáveis de controle de movimento do analógico
local toqueAtual = nil
local vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local raioMaximo = 35 -- Raio menor: anda devagar só pertinho do centro e atinge velocidade máxima rapidamente

-- Detecta quando o dedo/mouse pressiona a zona do analógico
zonaToque.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and toqueAtual == nil then
        toqueAtual = input
        vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    end
end)

-- Detecta o dedo/mouse arrastando
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == toqueAtual and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local absPos = fundoAnalogico.AbsolutePosition
        local absSize = fundoAnalogico.AbsoluteSize
        local centroX = absPos.X + (absSize.X / 2)
        local centroY = absPos.Y + (absSize.Y / 2)
        
        local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - Vector2.new(centroX, centroY)
        local distancia = delta.Magnitude
        
        -- O pino verde continua indo longe livremente (até 110 pixels)
        local raioVisualMax = 110
        local pinoDelta = delta
        if distancia > raioVisualMax then
            pinoDelta = delta.Unit * raioVisualMax
        end
        pinoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, pinoDelta.X, 0.5, pinoDelta.Y)
        
        -- Movimento limpo: Lento apenas bem perto do centro (zona morta de 4 pixels), rápido no resto
        if distancia > 4 then
            vetorMovimento = delta / raioMaximo
            if vetorMovimento.Magnitude > 1 then
                vetorMovimento = vetorMovimento.Unit
            end
        else
            vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        end
    end
end)

-- Função para soltar o analógico
local function soltarAnalogico(input)
    if input == toqueAtual then
        toqueAtual = nil
        vetorMovimento = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        pinoAnalogico.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    end
end

zonaToque.InputEnded:Connect(soltarAnalogico)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(soltarAnalogico)

-- Loop principal: Movimento fluido e limpo
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local personagem = LocalPlayer.Character
    if personagem and personagem:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        if vetorMovimento.Magnitude > 0 then
            local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local rightVector = Camera.CFrame.RightVector
            
            local frente = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z).Unit
            local direita = Vector3.new(rightVector.X, 0, rightVector.Z).Unit
            
            local direcaoMundo = (frente * -vetorMovimento.Y) + (direita * vetorMovimento.X)
            personagem.Humanoid:Move(direcaoMundo, false)
        else
            personagem.Humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), false)
        end

        if estaPulando then
            personagem.Humanoid.Jump = true
        end
    end
end)

-- Services

    local humanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Runtime discovery

for _, v in ipairs(runtime:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name ~= "Guide" and v.Name ~= "Planes" and v.Name ~= "TycoonTemplate" then
        tycoonNumber = v.Name
        break
    end
end

if not tycoonNumber then
    warn("[ATM v4] Tycoon not found!")
    return
end

-- ── Color Constants for Smart Mode ─────────────────
-- Royal Purple = money-making buildings (priority 1)

local BRIGHT_BLUE  = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")

-- ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════╗

local function formatMoney(n)
    if n >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.2fB", n / 1e9)
    elseif n >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.2fM", n / 1e6)
    elseif n >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3)
    end
    return tostring(math.floor(n))
end

local function formatUptime(seconds)
    local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
    local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
    local s = math.floor(seconds % 60)
    return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
end

local function getHRP()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

--- Classify a button's priority based on its Touch part color
local function getButtonPriority(button)
    local touch = button:FindFirstChild("Touch")
    if not touch or not touch:IsA("BasePart") then return 3 end

    local brick = touch.BrickColor
    if brick == ROYAL_PURPLE then
        return 1 -- money makers first
    elseif brick == BRIGHT_BLUE then
        return 2 -- security / checkin second
    end
    return 3 -- everything else last
end

--- Returns purchasable buttons sorted by current strategy
local function getButtons()
    local validButtons = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(buttonFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local devProduct = child:GetAttribute("DevProductId")
        local gamepass   = child:GetAttribute("GamepassId")
        if (devProduct == 0 or devProduct == nil)
        and (gamepass == 0 or gamepass == nil) then
            local touch = child:FindFirstChild("Touch")
            if touch then
                table.insert(validButtons, child)
            end
        end
    end

    if config.buyStrategy == "Smart" then
        -- Sort by priority tier first, then cheapest within each tier
        table.sort(validButtons, function(a, b)
            local prioA = getButtonPriority(a)
            local prioB = getButtonPriority(b)
            if prioA ~= prioB then
                return prioA < prioB
            end
            local costA = a:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            local costB = b:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            return costA < costB
        end)
    elseif config.buyStrategy == "Most Expensive First" then
        table.sort(validButtons, function(a, b)
            local costA = a:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            local costB = b:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            return costA > costB
        end)
    else -- Cheapest First
        table.sort(validButtons, function(a, b)
            local costA = a:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            local costB = b:GetAttribute("Cost") or math.huge
            return costA < costB
        end)
    end

    return validButtons
end

local function getRebirthRequirement()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
        if not playerGui then return math.huge end
        -- Exact path: PlayerGui.UI.Menus.Rebirth.Requirements.Details.Money
        local ui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("UI")
        if not ui then return math.huge end
        local menus = ui:FindFirstChild("Menus")
        if not menus then return math.huge end
        local rebirth = menus:FindFirstChild("Rebirth")
        if not rebirth then return math.huge end
        local requirements = rebirth:FindFirstChild("Requirements")
        if not requirements then return math.huge end
        local details = requirements:FindFirstChild("Details")
        if not details then return math.huge end
        local moneyLabel = details:FindFirstChild("Money")
        if not moneyLabel then return math.huge end

        -- Format: "Price: $currentCash/$225K"
        -- We want the number after the /
        local text = moneyLabel.Text
        local required = text:match("/(%$[%d%.]+[KMBkmb]?)")
        if not required then return math.huge end

        -- Strip the $ sign
        required = required:gsub("%$", "")
        local num    = tonumber(required:match("([%d%.]+)")) or 0
        local suffix = required:upper():match("([KMB])") or ""
        if suffix == "K" then num = num * 1e3
        elseif suffix == "M" then num = num * 1e6
        elseif suffix == "B" then num = num * 1e9 end
        return num
    end)
    return ok and result or math.huge
end
